name: supdance-canvas
description: Connect Codex to the SupDance web canvas through the local SupDance Canvas Agent.

interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to your SupDance canvas through a local desktop Agent. Read and summarize the current canvas, create and edit nodes, and use the available canvas workflows. Requires the SupDance Canvas Agent, Node.js 18+, and a locally running Codex desktop session. Generation is performed only when requested and subject to the connected canvas account’s limits.
